001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002
003/**
004 * Represents a frigate ({@code Fragata}) occupying four consecutive positions.
005 * North and south bearings place it vertically; east and west place it horizontally.
006 */
007public class Frigate extends Ship {
008    /** Number of positions occupied by a frigate. */
009    private static final Integer SIZE = 4;
010    /** Category name used to identify frigates. */
011    private static final String NAME = "Fragata";
012
013    /**
014     * Creates a frigate extending from the supplied position towards increasing
015     * row indices for a vertical bearing or increasing column indices for a
016     * horizontal bearing. Board boundaries are checked when adding it to a fleet.
017     *
018     * @param bearing the non-null cardinal direction of the frigate
019     * @param pos the non-null topmost or leftmost position of the frigate
020     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if {@code bearing} is {@link Compass#UNKNOWN}
021     */
022    public Frigate(Compass bearing, IPosition pos) throws IllegalArgumentException {
023        super(Frigate.NAME, bearing, pos);
024        switch (bearing) {
025            case NORTH:
026            case SOUTH:
027                for (int r = 0; r < SIZE; r++)
028                    getPositions().add(new Position(pos.getRow() + r, pos.getColumn()));
029                break;
030            case EAST:
031            case WEST:
032                for (int c = 0; c < SIZE; c++)
033                    getPositions().add(new Position(pos.getRow(), pos.getColumn() + c));
034                break;
035            default:
036                throw new IllegalArgumentException("ERROR! invalid bearing for thr frigate");
037        }
038    }
039
040    /**
041     * Returns the fixed size of a frigate.
042     *
043     * @return four occupied positions
044     */
045    @Override
046    public Integer getSize() {
047        return Frigate.SIZE;
048    }
049
050}
